data.goal: Fix the `CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT` template in the Rich console so the `<html>` tag wraps `<head>` and `<body>`, making `export_html()` produce valid HTML.

edit_targets.expected_behavior_change: Reorder the HTML template so the `<html>` opening tag appears before `<head>` and the `</html>` closing tag appears after `</body>`.

implementation_steps: Step 1: In `rich/console.py`, locate the module-level string constant `CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT`.

Step 2: Modify `CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT` by moving the `<html>` opening tag (and any attributes) to the position immediately before the `<head>` opening tag, ensuring the `</html>` closing tag remains after the `</body>` closing tag. For example, if the template currently contains `<head>...</head>\n<html>`, change it to `<html>\n<head>...</head>`.
risks: If other code or tests do brittle string matching on the exact whitespace or tag order of `export_html()` output, they may need minor updates.
